fr-05-17746.quote: "Notice is hereby given that the Department of State has terminated the statutory debarment against Orbit/FR, Inc. pursuant to Section 38(g)(4) of the Arms Export Control Act (AECA) (22 U.S.C. 2778) and Sec. 127.11 of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120-130)."

ndaa26.quote: "Section 238(a) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025 (Public Law 118-159; 138 Stat. 1842) is amended by inserting ``or fiscal year 2026'' after ``fiscal year 2025''."
ndaa26.ko: 2025 회계연도 국방수권법(공법 118-159; 138 Stat. 1842) 제238조 (a)항은 "2025 회계연도" 뒤에 "또는 2026 회계연도"를 넣는 것으로 개정된다.
